hero.eyebrow: Web Design & Development · Hermosa Beach, CA
hero.body: We listen, solve problems, and build highly-converting websites that take your brand to whole new heights. Great design backed by structurally-sound development, so your business shows up online the way it truly deserves to.

coreTruth.h2: There Is Often a Gap Between How Great a Business Is and How Clearly That Comes Across Online.
coreTruth.body1: Our goal is to help bridge that gap, so you can connect more clearly with the people you are meant to serve, build genuine trust, and create a greater impact through your website.
coreTruth.body2: When the experience feels right, taking the next step feels natural. That is what thoughtful design and purposeful development make possible.
coreTruth.quote: Being part of that process, helping ideas come to life, is what drives everything we do.

whyBluebay.h2: We Build Websites That Help Your Business Grow.
whyBluebay.body: Good design should do more than look beautiful, it should work. Every decision we make comes back to one question: does this help your business connect, build trust, and grow? Five principles guide every project we take on.

pillars.title: Clarity
pillars.desc: Clear, natural messaging that helps visitors immediately understand who you are, what you offer, and why it matters to them.

pillars.title: Intentional Design
pillars.desc: Every layout, typeface, color, and detail is chosen with purpose, to create an experience that feels right and moves people forward.

pillars.title: Performance
pillars.desc: Fast, mobile-first builds grounded in how real people actually browse, because a beautiful site that loads slowly loses people before they even begin.

pillars.title: Transparency
pillars.desc: We keep you in the loop at every step, from the first strategy conversation through launch day, so you always know exactly where things stand.

pillars.title: Built to Convert
pillars.desc: Every page has a purpose. Every call-to-action has a role. We build websites designed to turn the right visitors into the right clients.

process.h2: A Clear, Collaborative Process from Start to Launch

steps.title: Discovery & Strategy
steps.desc: We start by listening. We dig into your business, your audience, and your goals, then identify exactly what your website needs to do to support them.
steps.detail: Conversion audit · UX analysis · Competitor review

steps.title: Messaging & Structure
steps.desc: We map out your messaging, page structure, and user flow so every part of the site has a clear job, guiding the right people toward the right next step.
steps.detail: Messaging map · UX wireframe · Trust architecture

steps.title: Design & Development
steps.desc: We bring everything to life with intentional design and structurally-sound development, mobile-first, fast, and built to last.

steps.title: Launch & Grow
steps.desc: We launch your site, set up analytics, and stay close during the early days, so you go live with confidence and keep improving from real data.

about.h2: Nearly Two Decades of Building Things That Actually Work.
about.body1: Before founding Bluebay Agency, our founder spent nearly 17 years building and optimizing digital products for companies ranging from funded startups to billion-dollar enterprises, taking projects from conception through launch and refining them until they performed. That background is not common in a boutique agency, and it shapes how we approach every project we take on.
about.body2: We work with a small number of clients at a time, intentionally, so every project gets the care and attention it deserves. If you are ready to build a website that works as hard as you do, we would love to be part of that journey.

posts.title: Why Mobile-First Design Is Not Optional in 2025
posts.excerpt: Over 70% of your visitors arrive on mobile. If your site was designed for desktop first, you are designing for the minority and paying for it in lost conversions.

posts.title: The 7 Ways Websites Silently Lose Conversions
posts.excerpt: Most conversion problems are invisible. Slow load times, unclear CTAs, and poor trust signals are bleeding revenue daily without triggering a single error.

posts.title: From Traffic to Clients: Building Your Acquisition System
posts.excerpt: Traffic without conversion architecture is just noise. Learn how to architect your website as a system where every page has a role and every CTA has a purpose.

faq.still_question: Don't see your question answered here?

items.a: Most projects are completed in 2–14 business days depending on scope. Landing systems ship in 2–3 days. Growth websites in 5–7 days. Full Conversion Sprints in 10–14 days. We maintain these timelines by keeping our client roster intentionally small.

We build highly-converting websites, but the work behind them goes deeper than design. Strategy, messaging, structure, and lead generation all work together so your website becomes a genuine business asset that keeps delivering over time.

items.q: What do I need to get started?
items.a: Very little. We only need your business details, offer information, any available assets like photography or existing brand images, and access to your current website if applicable. We handle the strategy, copy direction, design, and engineering. Most clients are surprised by how streamlined the process is.

Yes. Optional ongoing optimization, website and landing page improvements are available as a monthly retainer. Many clients find that ongoing refinement significantly compounds the ROI of their initial build.

items.q: Will my website be optimized for SEO?
items.a: Yes. Every build includes technical SEO structure: metadata, OG tags, schema markup, performance optimization, and mobile-first architecture. SEO is woven into the engineering from day one, a foundational layer of every project we deliver.

items.q: What makes Bluebay Agency different from other agencies?
items.a: We take the time to actually listen. Every project starts with understanding your business, your clients, and what success looks like for you, then we build around that. Nearly 17 years of experience means we know what works, and we bring that knowledge to every project we take on.

items.q: How many clients do you work with at once?
items.a: We keep our roster intentionally small, usually 3–5 active projects at a time. It means more focus, faster turnaround, and a better experience for everyone we work with. It also means availability is limited, so if the timing feels right, it is worth reaching out sooner rather than later.
